The '''XR-32 hunter droid''' was a new model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model employed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. They were deployed during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]]<ref name="Time-3">{{TOR dates|3}}</ref><ref name="Eve of Destruction">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Eve of Destruction|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="Time-4">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> in the northwestern [[Blastfield Shipyards]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Drizan]], a member of the local [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] resistance, convinced [[the Barsen'thor]] to destroy a number of them to thin the Imperial forces in the area and allow [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] scouts to sneak into the area.
